summary.name: bugfree.ai
summary.one_liner: bugfree.ai is an AI-powered platform for practicing software engineering system design and behavioral interview questions.
use_cases: Running AI mock interviews before job interviews
Reviewing real interview experiences from top tech companies
Tailoring interview answers to your resume
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a question bank of 150+ system design problems, 30+ object-oriented design problems, 500+ data interview questions, and 60+ behavioral problems. It offers guided walkthroughs covering feature requirements, trade-off analysis, and component diagrams, with feedback on questions such as URL Shortener and Design Instagram. It also covers metrics, SQL, A/B testing, and case studies through guided frameworks. Users can customize answers with their resume and receive AI-driven mock interviews and feedback. The page claims access to 3000+ real interview experiences from companies like Meta and Amazon.
notable: 150+ system design problems with AI-driven feedback and mock interviews
Resume-customized answers and STARL behavioral answer examples
Comparison table against Design Guru, System Design Interview, and geeksforgeeks
caveats: Pricing and paid tiers are not stated on the page
Success claims and user testimonials are marketing content and not verified
